lo_assumption: differential rail-to-rail CMOS square LO, 50% duty, 30 ps edges, 50 ohm source, 2.44 GHz
pad_assumption: 2 ohm + 1 pF per leg (rftxpad allocation), 50 ohm differential DC-blocked load

board_match.method: driver differential output admittance at the pad (tt, code 15) conjugate-matched to 50 ohm differential by an L-section; inductor Q=30 (series loss in simulation), ideal capacitors, ideal 1:1 balun not included (budget ~0.5 dB).
